lines.en: label sportswars13:
scene fivelegs1
: Aaaaaaand back to reality!
lines.zh: : 好——了，回到现实吧！

lines.en: : How confident are you in that statement? Because it appears to me that you are still very much detached.
lines.zh: : 你对这句话有多大把握？因为在我看来，你还是很脱线。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m kind of hanging on by a thread right now. But hey, at least there haven’t been any casualties so far. And that’s saying a lot since today has been extremely dangerous in many different ways.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我现在差不多就剩一口气吊着了。不过嘿，至少目前还没有人员伤亡。这已经很了不起了，毕竟今天在很多方面都危险得要命。

lines.en: : Right. But at what point are you going to be explaining why you’re holding a pair of arms?
lines.zh: : 是。不过你打算什么时候解释一下，为什么你手里拎着两条胳膊？

lines.en: scene fivelegs2
: It’s not a true pair. They’re both right arms.
lines.zh: : 这不算一对。两条都是右臂。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That explains everything.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。这就解释了一切。

lines.en: : See? This is why we’re friends. Always on the same wavelength.
lines.zh: : 瞧？这就是我们为什么是朋友。永远在一个频道上。

lines.en: : I’m very worried about you.
lines.zh: : 我很担心你。

lines.en: scene fivelegs3
: Me too! But that doesn’t matter because the time has come for our final outdoor competition! And with the second floor only one point away from tying this thing, the stakes have never been higher!
lines.zh: : 我也是！不过这没关系，因为我们最后一项户外比赛的时间到了！而且二层只差一分就能扳平，赌注从未如此之高！

lines.en: : The stakes have been higher on many occasions, actually.
lines.zh: : 事实上，很多场合的赌注都比这高。

lines.en: : In fact, even if we win right now, the second floor could still win the competition-
lines.zh: : 事实上，就算我们现在赢了，二层也还有可能赢下整场比赛——

lines.en: : Shut it, Makoto! I’m just trying to get everybody hyped up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Makoto！我只是想让大家兴奋起来！

lines.en: : Is hyping us up even necessary after the game we just witnessed?
lines.zh: : 刚看完那场比赛，还有必要给我们打鸡血吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think it’s all downhill from here, Imani. Death ball is going to be hard to top even if the entire thing already seems like a blur.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我觉得接下来只会一路走下坡了，Imani。死亡球很难被超越，尽管整件事现在看起来已经像一团模糊的影子。

lines.en: : You’d think it would be hard to top! But you’ve yet to experience the next Imani-original competition — the five-legged race!
lines.zh: : 你会以为很难超越！可你们还没体验过下一个 Imani 原创项目——五足赛跑！

lines.en: : Let me guess — you ordered legs as well?
lines.zh: : 我猜猜——你还订了腿？

lines.en: : These arms are going to be legs today.
lines.zh: : 今天这些胳膊就是腿。

lines.en: scene fivelegs4
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : My black market guy is on vacation this month. These were all I could get on such short notice. So, for the sake of everyone involved in today’s contest, we’re going to have to use our imagination.
lines.zh: : 我的黑市供货商这个月休假去了。这么短的时间我只能弄到这些。所以，为了今天比赛的所有参与者着想，我们得发挥一下想象力。

lines.en: : To do what, though? Surely you don’t intend to just...repeat the relay race while making the girls carry an arm, do you?
lines.zh: : 可要想象什么？你该不会打算就……再跑一次接力赛，只是让女生们多拿一条胳膊吧？

lines.en: : Not at all. The rules are actually really simple this time.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。这次的规则其实特别简单。

lines.en: scene fivelegs5
: And they revolve almost entirely around these two strange mannequins I picked up from Goodwill!
lines.zh: : 而且几乎完全围绕着我从 Goodwill 淘来的这两个奇怪的人体模型！

lines.en: : I honestly can’t tell if Imani’s contests are way worse or way better than the ones we normally come up with.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我分不清 Imani 的比赛是比我们平时搞的糟糕得多，还是精彩得多。

lines.en: : I miss the date war.
lines.zh: : 我想念约会战争。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : I, for one, am grateful for these new contests. The unique spin Miss Imai is placing on all of these classic games I’d only read about before is making them out to be far more interesting than I expected.
lines.zh: : 至少我个人很感激这些新项目。Imai 老师给这些我以前只在书里读过的经典游戏加上的独特改动，让它们比我预想的有趣得多。

lines.en: : Now, if I could just recommend a horseback riding competition so I might actually win something for once-
lines.zh: : 现在，要是能让我推荐一个骑马比赛，我说不定终于能赢一次——

lines.en: : Sure, Touka! Ask for horseback riding! We all know what ya really mean by that!
lines.zh: : 好啊，Touka！去要骑马比赛吧！我们都知道你真正的意思是什么！

lines.en: : Can y’all shut your mouths so I can explain this thing already?!
lines.zh: : 你们能不能都闭上嘴，好让我把这事儿讲完？！

lines.en: : To any girls participating, make your way to the center circle now!
lines.zh: : 参赛的女生们，现在请到中圈来！

lines.en: scene black
scene fivelegs6
: It appears we meet again, Zagull Throat Spear...Lidearel Lightfoot. I see you’ve come prepared for failure this time.
lines.zh: : 看来我们又见面了，Zagull Throat Spear……Lidearel Lightfoot。我看你这次是做好了失败的准备来的。

lines.en: : I just...don’t want to get hit in the head again...
lines.zh: : 我只是……不想再被砸到头了……

lines.en: : We’re not the only team that’s made changes, Molly. It appears that you’ve abandoned your former partner completely.
lines.zh: : 做出调整的队伍可不止我们，Molly。看来你已经彻底把前任搭档给抛弃了。

lines.en: : A stag beetle crawled up my leg and informed me that I must take place in this competition or that my heart will be torn from my chest by the shadow of contempt.
lines.zh: : 一只锹甲爬上我的腿，告诉我必须参加这场比赛，否则我的心会被轻蔑的阴影从胸腔里撕出来。

lines.en: scene fivelegs7
: Well, it’s good to see you two are on the same page already.
lines.zh: : 嗯，很高兴看到你们俩已经想到一块儿去了。

lines.en: : The Priestess of Fallen Snow and I have raised our prayer to max level and are prepared to resurrect our mannequin’s corpse without any reagents whatsoever!
lines.zh: : 落雪巫女和我已经把祈祷升到满级，准备好在不需要任何材料的情况下复活我们人体模型的尸体了！

lines.en: : Do anyone else’s ears tingle?
lines.zh: : 还有谁的耳朵在发麻吗？

lines.en: : Mine kind of do, but...I think it’s just the helmet...
lines.zh: : 我的有点，不过……我觉得只是头盔的关系……

lines.en: scene fivelegs8
: Like I was saying, the rules of this contest are simple! Each team will take an arm, avoid Catherine, and then replace your mannequin’s missing leg!
lines.zh: : 就像我刚才说的，比赛规则很简单！每队拿一条胳膊，避开 Catherine，然后把你们人体模型缺的那条腿补上！

lines.en: : With...with the arm?
lines.zh: : 用……用胳膊？

lines.en: : Well, there ain’t any legs, Ayane! Have you guys been paying any attention at all?!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，根本没有腿啊，Ayane！你们到底有没有在听？！

lines.en: : Miss Imai...can I ask a question?...
lines.zh: : Imai 老师……我能问个问题吗？……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : But...Catherine-
lines.zh: : 可是……Catherine——

lines.en: : You’ll cross that bridge when you come to it.
lines.zh: : 船到桥头自然直。

lines.en: : What a strange and curious day it’s been so far.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止，这一天真是古怪又离奇。

lines.en: : Probably the strangest one I’ve had...maybe ever, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 大概是我经历过最奇怪的一天……仔细想想，也许是有史以来最奇怪的。

lines.en: : Not me. I am what’s called an “exhibitionist” now.
lines.zh: : 我可不是。我现在成了所谓的“暴露狂”了。

lines.en: scene fivelegs9
: What is that, exactly? Some sort of...artist? No. Athlete perhaps?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么？某种……艺术家？不对。也许是运动员？

lines.en: : I believe it is the term for people who perform lewd acts in public.
lines.zh: : 我想，那指的是在公共场合做猥亵行为的人。

lines.en: scene fivelegs10
: Lewd...acts?
lines.zh: : 猥亵……行为？

lines.en: : I said what I meant and I meant what I said. But this does not change who I am. I am still the Tsuneyo Tojo you are somewhat familiar with.
lines.zh: : 我说什么就是什么，我说到做到。但这不改变我是谁。我依然是你们多少还算熟悉的 Tsuneyo Tojo。

lines.en: : I don’t believe myself to be familiar with you at all, Tsuneyo. Especially if this...exhibitionist thing is not just a bit you’ve created to toy with my heart.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得自己对你有多熟悉，Tsuneyo。尤其是如果这“暴露狂”的一套不只是你编出来玩弄我感情的小把戏的话。

lines.en: : There is no need, for you are but one of two members on our floor who have yet to acknowledge your attraction to me. Your heart can not be tampered with unless I kill something you love.
lines.zh: : 大可不必，因为我们这一层里还没承认被我吸引的人只有两个，你就是其中之一。除非我杀掉你心爱的东西，否则你的心是动不了的。

lines.en: : You can have my sister. Just spare my Misaki.
lines.zh: : 我姐姐给你。放过我的 Misaki 就行。

lines.en: scene fivelegs11
: Your sister?...
lines.zh: : 你姐姐？……

lines.en: : I have never cooked with human meat before. I eagerly anticipate this challenge.
lines.zh: : 我以前从没用人肉做过菜。我非常期待这次挑战。

lines.en: : And I eagerly anticipate the end of this competition so that I may reset and try again for a normal day tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 而我非常期待这场比赛赶紧结束，好让我重置一下，明天再试着过个正常的一天。

lines.en: scene fivelegs12
: This...feels a lot more real than I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 这……比我想象的要真实得多。

lines.en: : Because it is real, Ayane. You think I’d half ass this competition after Touka handed me her credit card? Hell nah. Only the best for my girls.
lines.zh: : 因为它本来就是真的，Ayane。Touka 把信用卡都交给我了，你觉得我会敷衍了事吗？想得美。给我的姑娘们只上最好的。

lines.en: : The fact that...they’re both right arms...implies that more than one person died for this competition...doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 问题是……两条都是右臂……这意味着为这场比赛死掉的人不止一个……对吧？

lines.en: : Or that the person who died for this competition was born with more than one right arm, which would make this investigation way more interesting.
lines.zh: : 或者，为这场比赛死掉的那个人天生长了不止一条右臂，那这桩调查就会有趣得多了。

lines.en: : So we just...put the leg-
lines.zh: : 那我们就把腿——

lines.en: : Arm.
lines.zh: : 胳膊。

lines.en: scene fivelegs13
: So we just...put the arm into the...mannequin’s...leg hole?
lines.zh: : 那我们就把胳膊插进……人体模型的……腿洞里？

lines.en: : And avoid Catherine.
lines.zh: : 还要避开 Catherine。

lines.en: : Do you-
lines.zh: : 那你——

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Oh, okay...
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧……

lines.en: scene fivelegs14
: I have a real problem with the fact that my first intentions with this disembodied limb are to do inappropriate things with it. Perhaps I’m even more of a pervert than I formerly believed?
lines.zh: : 我对这条断肢的第一个念头竟然是拿它做不该做的事，这让我很有意见。也许我比我以前以为的还要变态？

lines.en: : I do not know if I am permitted to handle lifeless limbs in spring. The tenets of this season have not yet been fully established in His great book yet.
lines.zh: : 我不知道春天是否允许我摆弄没有生命的肢体。这个季节的教义还没有在祂的伟大之书里完全确立。

lines.en: scene fivelegs15
: Can’t you just ask? I thought your divine powers allowed you to communicate with your patron at any given moment?
lines.zh: : 你就不能直接问问吗？我以为你的神力能让你随时和你的主沟通呢？

lines.en: : Communication has been severed. It’s like my ears have been stuffed with special filters that keep His message out. I can’t help but worry that something may have happened in my absence.
lines.zh: : 沟通被切断了。就好像我的耳朵被塞进了特殊的过滤器，把祂的讯息挡在外面。我不由得担心，我不在的这段时间里是不是出了什么事。

lines.en: : Meh. If there’s anything I understand about gods, it’s that they always come back in some form. So even if He Who Drinks the Light is currently missing, I’m sure he’ll turn up soon enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯。要说我了解神明什么，那就是他们总会以某种形式回归。所以就算“饮光者”现在失踪了，我相信他很快就会现身。

lines.en: scene fivelegs16
: I hope you are correct.
lines.zh: : 希望你是对的。

lines.en: : I would not be able to survive in the dark.
lines.zh: : 我无法在黑暗中活下去。

lines.en: scene noonsky
: Okay! Are there any final questions before we kick off our final real-ish sports day contest?!
lines.zh: : 好了！在我们开始最后一场“勉强算真的”运动会项目之前，还有什么问题吗？！

lines.en: : Um-
: Any questions not about Catherine!
lines.zh: : 除了关于 Catherine 的问题都行！

lines.en: : Imani! Wanna go out some time?
lines.zh: : Imani！有空一起出去吗？

lines.en: : Only if I can surrender you to the local dog pound for being such a BITCH! Ayooooo!
lines.zh: : 除非我能把你这个臭婊子送进当地的收容所！哎哟喂！

lines.en: : I hope you’re happy, Imani. You’ve just earned yourself a detention on Monday as well.
lines.zh: : 我希望你满意了，Imani。你又给自己挣了个周一的留堂。

lines.en: : What?! I can’t get detention! I have tenure!
lines.zh: : 什么？！我不能留堂！我有终身教职！

lines.en: : You’ve only been here for-
lines.zh: : 你才来这儿——

lines.en: : Miku, close your ears!
lines.zh: : Miku，捂住耳朵！

lines.en: : Wha- oh! Okay! Done!
lines.zh: : 什——哦！好！捂好了！

lines.en: : Go, go, go, go, go!
lines.zh: : 冲，冲，冲，冲，冲！

lines.en: scene fivelegs17
scene fivelegs18
: D...Dragon!!!!!!
: That’s no dragon! That’s Catherine!...........Probably!
lines.zh: : 那不是龙！那是 Catherine！...........大概吧！

lines.en: : Catherine’s an alligator?!
lines.zh: : Catherine 是短吻鳄？！

lines.en: : Imani’s been tryin’ to kill us with those all heckin’ day! Y’all are just the next group who has to deal with it!
lines.zh: : Imani 一整天都在用那玩意儿想弄死我们！你们不过是下一批要对付它的倒霉蛋！

lines.en: : Correction! Catherine is a crocodile. And the only thing she hates more than being called an alligator is when people wave meat in front of her.
lines.zh: : 更正！Catherine 是鳄鱼。而她唯一比被叫成短吻鳄更讨厌的事，就是有人在她面前晃肉。

lines.en: : Do you think she’s friendly?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她友善吗？

lines.en: : She appears to be part of the bronze dragonflight at first glance, so she likely holds some sort of dominion over time! Remain vigilant or time may be reset at any moment!
lines.zh: : 乍一看她像是青铜龙军团的一员，所以她很可能掌握着某种对时间的统治权！保持警惕，否则时间随时可能被重置！

lines.en: : You’re right, but not in the way you think you are!
lines.zh: : 你说得对，但不是你以为的那种对！

lines.en: : What even makes an alligator different from a crocodile in the first place?!
lines.zh: : 短吻鳄和鳄鱼到底有什么区别啊？！

lines.en: scene fivelegs17
: A few things! But the easiest way to tell them apart is by their snout. Catherine here has a V-shaped snout, which means she’s a crocodile because V stands for vcrocodile.
lines.zh: : 区别有好几点！但最简单的分辨方法是看吻部。Catherine 的吻部是 V 形的，所以她是鳄鱼，因为 V 代表“V 鳄鱼”。

lines.en: : But if she had a u-shaped snout, she’d be an alligator because-
lines.zh: : 可如果她的吻部是 U 形的，她就是短吻鳄，因为——

lines.en: : Because U stands for ualligator?
lines.zh: : 因为 U 代表“U 短吻鳄”？

lines.en: : No, U stands for “You suck!” Take that, nerd!
lines.zh: : 不对，U 代表“你真逊！”接招吧，书呆子！

lines.en: scene fivelegs19
: Why am I being made fun of?! I’m the only one who’s competed in three contests today! I should be praised for how hard-working and durable I am!
lines.zh: : 为什么要取笑我？！今天我是唯一一个参加了三项比赛的人！我这么勤快又这么耐操，应该被夸才对！

lines.en: : Girl, there ain’t no time for praise! You’ve got a hungry friggin’ crocodile trying to steal your fifth arm! Defend yourselves!
lines.zh: : 妹子，没时间夸你了！有只饿疯了的鳄鱼正想抢你的第五条胳膊！自卫啊！

lines.en: : I do wish Miss Imai would have informed me she was going to use my card to purchase live animals so I could have scheduled medical exams for all of them. This is getting out of hand.
lines.zh: : 我真希望 Imai 老师能提前告诉我她要用我的卡买活体动物，好让我给它们都安排体检。这真是越来越 out of hand 了。

lines.en: : Don’t you mean “out of arm?”
lines.zh: : 你不是想说 out of arm 吗？

lines.en: scene fivelegs20
: No. I mean-
lines.zh: : 不是。我是说——

lines.en: scene fivelegs21
: Oh! “Out of hand!” I made a pun!
lines.zh: : 哦！out of hand！我玩了个双关！

lines.en: : I’m actually quite funny, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我其实挺幽默的，是吧？

lines.en: : Did you hear about the crocodile and the rooster who created a child together?
lines.zh: : 你听说过鳄鱼和公鸡一起生了个孩子的笑话吗？

lines.en: scene fivelegs22
: Is such a thing even possible?
lines.zh: : 这种事可能吗？

lines.en: : It was a croc-a-doodle-doo.
lines.zh: : 那是一只 croc-a-doodle-doo。

lines.en: : A what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Croc-a-doodle-doo.
lines.zh: : Croc-a-doodle-doo。

lines.en: : Because the noise a rooster makes is “cock-a-doodle-doo.” And if you grab the cock and move it out of the way-
lines.zh: : 因为公鸡的叫声是“cock-a-doodle-doo”。而你抓住 cock 把它挪开——

lines.en: : Please don’t say it like that.
lines.zh: : 求你别这么说了。

lines.en: : If you bend the cock to the side-
lines.zh: : 你要是把 cock 往边上掰——

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, stop it.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，别说了。

lines.en: : Please just allow me to handle the cock the way I want to handle it or the joke will not make sense.
lines.zh: : 请让我按我想要的方式处理这根 cock，不然这个笑话就不成立了。

lines.en: scene fivelegs23
: Hah...you’d think I’d be able to discern by now whether or not people are being sincere with me. But with you, I feel like I understand that even less than I do with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哈……你会以为到现在我总该能分辨出别人是不是真心对我了。可面对你，我觉得我连对 Sensei 的那点把握都没有。

lines.en: : I am a mysterious, noodle-filled, cock-handling exhibitionist. You should not blame yourself for being unable to keep up with my quick-witted genius.
lines.zh: : 我是一个神秘兮兮、满肚子面条、会摆弄 cock 的暴露狂。你跟不上我的机智天才，这不能怪你自己。

lines.en: : You and Yasu both. She’s a genius of sorts too — just in a way that none of us can come close to grasping.
lines.zh: : 你和 Yasu 都是。她也算是某种天才——只是那种天才我们谁都摸不着边。

lines.en: : In what way would you consider her a genius?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她在哪方面算天才？

lines.en: scene fivelegs24
: Well, you know that religion she’s always preaching about?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你知道她总在传的那个宗教吧？

lines.en: : Yes, I am familiar with her only character trait.
lines.zh: : 知道，我对她唯一的性格特征很熟悉。

lines.en: : She has more! You just don’t understand them yet! But, what I was trying to say is that, I looked into some of what she preaches with my mother recently and, as it turns out, she isn’t making any of this up.
lines.zh: : 她还有别的！你只是还没搞懂而已！不过，我想说的是，我最近和母亲一起查了查她传的那些东西，结果发现她根本不是在胡编。

lines.en: : It appears that Yasu’s beliefs are either derivative of or an exact replication of a religion that used to be practiced in Kumon-mi long before any of us were born.
lines.zh: : 看起来 Yasu 的信仰要么源自、要么完全复制了我们所有人出生之前很久在 Kumon-mi 盛行过的一个宗教。

lines.en: : So long, in fact, that if it were not for my family’s library, I doubt we’d have uncovered any information at all.
lines.zh: : 久到如果不是靠我家的藏书，我怀疑我们根本查不到任何信息。

lines.en: : It’s been nearly two-hundred years since it’s shown up in text. But the few text accounts we were able to scrounge up mirror what she says almost one-to-one.
lines.zh: : 它已经有将近两百年没在文献中出现过了。但我们能扒出来的那几段文字记载，几乎和她说的分毫不差。

lines.en: : Which not only makes Yasu the apparent sole authority on this system of beliefs, but-
lines.zh: : 这不仅让 Yasu 成了这套信仰体系显而易见的唯一权威，而且——

lines.en: : Suspicious.
lines.zh: : 可疑。

lines.en: : I was thinking more along the lines of “a genius regarding all things surrounding it,” but yes. I suppose her knowledge is suspicious in a sense as well.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说的是“在与之相关的一切事情上都是天才”，不过也对。我想她的知识在某种意义上确实也可疑。

lines.en: : Can one even be a genius when it comes to a subject that can not be scientifically proven?
lines.zh: : 一个无法被科学证实的领域，也能出天才吗？

lines.en: : Maybe not. I’m not quite sure, exactly.
lines.zh: : 也许不能。我也说不太准。

lines.en: : But actually being a genius is far less important than convincing people you are one. And, in many ways, I don’t think we give Yasu enough credit.
lines.zh: : 不过，真正是不是天才，远没有让别人相信你是天才重要。而且在很多方面，我觉得我们低估了 Yasu。

lines.en: : She’s very rarely wrong about...well, anything.
lines.zh: : 她几乎从不犯错……对任何事都是。

lines.en: : Perhaps we are all geniuses in our own respect.
lines.zh: : 也许我们每个人在各自的意义上都是天才。

lines.en: : The hole is too small! I can’t get it in!
lines.zh: : 洞太小了！我插不进去！

lines.en: : Well...maybe not all of us.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许不是所有人。

lines.en: : Push...harder!
lines.zh: : 用……用力点！

lines.en: : I’m...pushing as hard as I can! It’s too tight!
lines.zh: : 我……我已经用尽全力了！太紧了！

lines.en: : I can’t last much longer! Hurry, Molly!
lines.zh: : 我撑不了多久了！快点，Molly！

lines.en: : Bear with the pain, Yasu! Just think about the release at the end!
lines.zh: : 忍着点疼，Yasu！想想最后释放的那一刻！

lines.en: scene fivelegs25
: Um...is it just me, or...
lines.zh: : 嗯……是我的错觉吗，还是……

lines.en: : Definitely not you. It’s been nonstop euphemisms ever since we defeated Catherine.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是你。自从我们打败 Catherine 之后，各种暗示就没停过。

lines.en: : It’s making it...kind of hard to focus, but...
lines.zh: : 这让我……有点难以集中注意力，不过……

lines.en: scene fivelegs26
: Not as hard as the fact that...I think our mannequin might be alive?...
lines.zh: : 没有“我觉得我们的人体模型可能是活的”这件事那么难……

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I saw him breathing a second ago. Just bear with it a little longer, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定一秒前还看到他在呼吸。再忍一忍吧，Sana。

lines.en: : He’s...stroking my hair...
lines.zh: : 他在……摸我的头发……

lines.en: : I’d stroke your hair too if I was a one-legged cyclops.
lines.zh: : 我要是个独腿独眼巨人，也会摸你的头发的。

lines.en: scene fivelegs27
: You’ve...said many strange things to me over the years, but...I think that one-
lines.zh: : 这些年来你对我说过很多奇怪的话，不过……我觉得这一句——

lines.en: : Silence, Sana! And stay still or I’ll never be able to get it in!
lines.zh: : 安静，Sana！别动，不然我永远也插不进去！

lines.en: : Please don’t do this as well.
lines.zh: : 求你别也来这套。

lines.en: : God, it’s so tight!
lines.zh: : 天哪，太紧了！

lines.en: scene fivelegs28
: There’s no way you aren’t doing this on purpose!
lines.zh: : 你绝对是故意的！

lines.en: : Almost there, Yasu! I’ve...just about got it!
lines.zh: : 快好了，Yasu！我……马上就进去了！

lines.en: : Steady! Hold! Hold!
lines.zh: : 稳住！撑住！撑住！

lines.en: scene fivelegs29
: Nnnngh!!!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯！！！

lines.en: : Oi! We’ll be able to heal in just a minute! Just keep holding this thing up or it’ll collapse onto both of us, Priestess!
lines.zh: : 喂！我们马上就能回血了！你继续把这玩意儿撑住，不然它会砸到我们俩身上，巫女！
: 我……感觉……不对劲……

lines.en: : So do I! But that happens any time I do strenuous activities and I can assure you it’s only a matter of-
lines.zh: : 我也是！不过我每次做剧烈运动都这样，我可以向你保证这只是——

lines.en: scene fivelegs30
: NGHHH! SOMETHING’S...COMING!
lines.zh: : 嗯啊啊啊！有东西……要出来了！

lines.en: : DAMN IT, AYANE! CAN YOU HURRY UP?!
lines.zh: : 该死，Ayane！你能不能快点？！

lines.en: : Uhh...OOC, are you okay? Do we need to-
lines.zh: : 呃……OOC，你还好吗？我们要不要——

lines.en: scene fivelegs31
: Spiderwebs. A calendar. The ones you keep inside.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛网。一本日历。你藏在里面的那种。

lines.en: : A god. A bucket. Heresy. A man who almost died.
lines.zh: : 一位神。一只桶。异端。一个差点死掉的男人。

lines.en: : A ghost. A moon. She’s lying. There’s nowhere we can hide.
lines.zh: : 一个幽灵。一轮月亮。她在撒谎。我们无处可藏。

lines.en: : We’re done. We’re doomed. We’re dying. The well has nearly dried.
lines.zh: : 我们完了。我们注定要死。我们正在死去。井几乎已经干涸。

lines.en: LINE BREAK
lines.zh: LINE BREAK

lines.en: scene noonsky
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊————————————————————！

lines.en: scene fivelegs32
: Yasu?! What’s wrong?!
lines.zh: : Yasu？！你怎么了？！

lines.en: : Head!...Hurts!...
: Wakana, do you have a key to the nurse’s office?!
lines.zh: : Wakana，你有医务室的钥匙吗？！

lines.en: : It’s in my office, but I can’t run-
lines.zh: : 在我办公室里，但我跑不动——

lines.en: : I’ll go get it and unlock the door!
lines.zh: : 我去拿，然后开门！

lines.en: : I...I didn’t mean to-
lines.zh: : 我……我不是故意的——

lines.en: : It’s not your fault, Molly. It’s likely just unfortunate timing.
lines.zh: : 这不是你的错，Molly。大概只是时机不巧。

lines.en: : Yasu, what is it? Another “message?”
lines.zh: : Yasu，怎么了？又一个“讯息”？

lines.en: : I am permanent...I am perfect! I am permanent...and perfect!
lines.zh: : 我是永恒的……我是完美的！我是永恒的……完美的！

lines.en: scene fivelegs33
: Tsuneyo! Can you- where did Tsuneyo go? She was here just a second ago.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo！你能——Tsuneyo 去哪儿了？她刚刚还在这儿。

lines.en: : It looked like she ran back inside just now. What’s going on with Yasu? I just got back from the taco stand and-
lines.zh: : 刚才她好像跑回屋里去了。Yasu 怎么了？我刚从塔可摊那边回来，然后——

lines.en: scene fivelegs32
: A bad migraine, most likely. But I need someone to help me carry her to the-
lines.zh: : 大概是严重的偏头痛。但我需要有人帮我把她抬到——

lines.en: : I’ll help!
lines.zh: : 我来帮忙！

lines.en: : I can help too!
lines.zh: : 我也能帮忙！

lines.en: : Just Ayane will be fine. But thank you, Molly.
lines.zh: : Ayane 一个人就够了。不过谢谢你，Molly。

lines.en: : Yasu, we’re going to lift you up now. Okay? We’ll get you to a bed to rest.
lines.zh: : Yasu，我们现在要把你抬起来了。好吗？我们会把你弄到床上去休息。

lines.en: : I am...permanent! I...am permanent!
lines.zh: : 我是……永恒的！我……是永恒的！

lines.en: : No one is permanent, but we can save our next one-sided philosophical debate for when you are not shaking in the dirt.
lines.zh: : 没有谁是永恒的，不过我们这场单方面的哲学辩论，可以等你不躺在地上发抖的时候再继续。

lines.en: scene black
: Ayane, I’ll take her legs. If you could just grab beneath her arms-
lines.zh: : Ayane，我来抬她的腿。你能不能托住她的腋下——

lines.en: : On it. Let’s go, Yasu. Imani should have the door unlocked in a minute.
lines.zh: : 明白。走吧，Yasu。Imani 应该马上就把门打开了。

lines.en: : Have...to warn...him! Have...to save...
lines.zh: : 必须……警告……他！必须……拯救……

lines.en: : The lamb!
lines.zh: : 那只羔羊！
